assets.heard: The convoy ahead carries food, medicine, and people who trusted our promise. Beyond these dunes, Meridian has gone silent. We will not leave them waiting.
Escort the relief vehicles along the marked road. Clear each ambush before the drivers advance, and keep repair crews close enough to reach damaged armor.
Do not scatter at the first contact. Tanks hold the approach while infantry sweep the shoulders. Every surviving truck gives the next settlement another chance.
I am coming with you. Bring our command team home with at least half its strength intact, and the archive will record a preservation commendation.
Recruits are watching how we answer this signal. Helix has cut the logistics relay, but a broken network is something disciplined soldiers can put right.
Establish a command lab, assign a tank to guard the approach, then send infantry to capture the relay. Hold it through the warned enemy responses.
Guard keeps armor where the infantry need it. Follow keeps support beside that armor. Practice both deliberately. A formation only works when its jobs agree.
Keep the Commander out of the first volley. Finish with at least half the hero hull intact to earn the Operation Preservation Commendation for our Archive.
These mountain relays carry the last trace of my brother. Helix is erasing the channel one station at a time. We need two working fronts.
Capture any two relays with infantry and hold them uncontested. The required time accumulates, so regroup when necessary instead of spending lives defending every meter.
Split armor and repair support into separate assignments. Watch the northeast and southeast approaches after the first capture. Their responses are finite and ours must endure.
Recover the signal without breaking the command team. Victory with the hero above half hull earns a preservation commendation, keeping all three relays also aids Cinder Ford.
The river guns can stop the convoy, but the wrecks below are still transmitting civilian calls. Voss is going down there. We will cover him.
Secure the Western Fire Control Post. Disable the Convoy Command Vehicle. And hold the Ford while the search proceeds. The marked crossings are your ground approaches.
Do not chase through the barrage. Keep repair support behind the river guns. Screen the banks with infantry. And escort every recovered survivor to the aid station.
A successful rescue strengthens the next operation. Preserve at least half of the hero hull at victory as well, and the archive records your command commendation.
Nyx left engineering marks through these works. The gates are closing behind us, and Kerrigan has promised to watch our backs. We take the foundry together.
Destroy both production nodes to cancel their unfinished units. Scout around the warehouses, capture the industrial works with infantry, then hold through the final warned response.
Armor and infantry need separate street approaches. Protect repair robots instead of letting them follow a chase. Their service keeps this limited force in the fight.
Completion opens another approach to the finale. Bring the hero home with at least half the hull intact for the preservation commendation, and leave nobody behind.
The Meridian Spire is ahead. Nyx controls the doors, but people are still trapped below them. We need those controls intact before we can demand answers.
Capture the forward deployment zone with infantry and hold it uncontested. Leave a guard there while the mixed strike force advances against the Helix headquarters.
Keep a route back to deployment. If the zone falls, recapture it before finishing the attack. Support earned at the foundry opens the northern ground passage.
This ends only when our people can leave safely. Win with the hero at half hull, or better, to record the final preservation commendation in the archive.
The district reports perfect order. Its clinic is dark, its gates are sealed, and a detained family is waiting for permission to breathe, restore the connection.
Reconnect the clinic substation, escort the families to medical shelter and protect the district until the power stabilizes. Marked controls require infantry to secure them.
Use shielded units to absorb contact, then withdraw before hull damage accumulates. Open a safe corridor for civilians rather than following every retreating hostile signal.
I will maintain the link beside you, complete the operation with my hull at least half intact, and the archive preserves a commendation for controlled force.
This is the night Meridian closed. Two gate controls remain responsive and Elias is calling from the far side. Procedure cannot decide what we do next.
Secure both gate control positions and keep their links active. Divide your infantry coverage. Support each group with shields and protect the route between the controls.
A single concentrated force cannot guard two separated switches. Watch the approaches, rotate damaged units out of contact, and let their shields recover before returning.
Keep the command link alive without sacrificing its operator. Victory with at least half my hull intact earns this operation. Preservation commendation in the archive.
Bastion guns cover the river and every prediction assumes we will answer with equal force. We need the crossing, not another field of burning transports.
Follow the marked objectives across the Ford, secure the necessary control positions before committing the main force, and keep an infantry screen beside the shield line.
The river narrows every approach. Let the formation compress through the crossing, then spread out beyond it. Coherent beams need sight lines and damaged shields need room.
Measure success by what survives the crossing. Complete the operation with my hull at least half intact to earn a preservation commendation and retain the record.
The Pruning Order names people as corrupted branches. Their records are still connected to this network. Before anyone erases them, we will inspect the evidence ourselves.
Advance through the marked network objectives in sequence. Secure each control with infantry. Protect the current link and avoid leaving your support behind a sealed approach.
Use mobile shields and focus beams to isolate defenders. Withdraw depleted units together. Preserving a trained force is more useful than accelerating a careless attack.
There must be a witness when the order is questioned. Bring me through victory with at least half hull intact for the archive preservation commendation.
The network calls Severance a clean operation. Nothing about Meridian has been clean. We are going to cut the controlling signal while keeping its victims connected.
Follow the marked control chain and secure the final objective. Keep infantry available for capture work and preserve a route for shielded support to rejoin you.
Do not spend the entire force on one exposed advance. Rotate the front line, concentrate coherent fire, and let recovered shields carry the next engagement.
I intend to remain here when the signal falls silent, finish with at least half my hull intact and the archive will keep our preservation commendation.
They built a city above these drains and forgot who kept it running. Now the tunnels are our road home. Keep your engines quiet until we surface.
Move through the marked passages and complete each objective in order. Keep infantry ahead where the route narrows and bring repair support through before rushing the next corner.
Our vehicles are fast, not invincible. Hit exposed defenders together, break contact when armor starts failing, and make the scrap we recover count for something.
And try bringing your Pathfinder back in one piece. Victory with at least half my hull earns a preservation commendation. The scrapyard remembers careful drivers.
Everybody wants this crossing. Nobody asks the people living beside it. We are taking a route through the noise and getting our own people across alive.
Secure the marked objectives around the Ford and keep the crossing open. Send infantry to control positions while the rigs cover their advance from firm ground.
Spread out after each narrow crossing. A clump of fast trucks is still one easy artillery target. Repair the wounded vehicles before you spend another batch.
We win by bringing people home, including me. Finish with my hull at half strength or better for the preservation commendation and another story around the fire.
That scrapyard looks like a graveyard to them, to us it is spare armor, working engines and enough parts to keep the outpost breathing another week.
Reach the marked salvage objectives and protect the crews working around them. Keep infantry near each control point and use your vehicles to screen the open approaches.
Do not charge past valuable wrecks while your armor burns. Recover what the root allows, repair between fights, and keep enough mobile force to leave safely.
The best trophy is a crew that comes back. Victory with my hull at least half intact earns a preservation accommodation for the outpost archive.
Wren has a reason for keeping this channel open. I want to hear it before somebody stronger decides silence is simpler. We go in together this time.
Follow the marked objectives and protect the people tied to the signal. Keep infantry ready for control points and avoid outrunning your repair and escort support.
Use the rigs to cover movement, not to block every narrow street. Take the space you need, repair what you can, and leave a way back.
I plan to hear the answer in person. Bring me through victory above half hull and claim the preservation commendation. We can argue about heroics afterward.
Dust Rangers, Iron Wardens, every patched engine in this canyon, this is what a coalition looks like. Nobody gets to decide our future without hearing us.
Complete the marked final objectives while keeping the coalition force connected. Infantry secure the controls. Armored rigs and repair crews keep their approach from closing behind them.
How strength is replacement and recovery, not throwing everything away. Focus fire, clear room for damaged vehicles, and rebuild the line before the next push.
Let us finish with a commander who can stand beside the others. Keep my hull at least half intact at victory for the final preservation commendation.
